Glossary of card game terms
The following is a
glossary
of terms used in
card games
. Besides the terms listed here, there are thousands of other common and uncommon slang terms. Terms in this glossary are not game-specific (e.g. specific to
bridge
,
hearts
,
poker
or
rummy
), but apply to a wide range of card games played with non-proprietary packs. It should not include terms solely related to casino or banking games. For glossaries that relate primarily to one game or family of similar games, see
Game-specific glossaries
.
